decisions.reason: As a core LED lighting product still given its own page in 2024, it fits the firm's existing knowledge base and offers enough continued market presence for the firm to keep learning and improving it rather than withdraw it.

The ceiling luminaire remains prominently marketed after its 2023 launch, which in this highly related product area suggests the firm can absorb customer feedback and sustain it with modest development effort.

This 2024 flexible LED spotlight is close to the firm's established competencies in luminaires, so despite limited history the firm is likely to retain it while it interprets first-round market results and refines the offer.

The multi-outlet ceiling canopy is a related extension of the firm's electrical and lighting know-how, and its own product page indicates enough commitment to keep it on the market while experience accumulates.

Although the low-voltage canopy may require somewhat more specialised adaptation and market education, it is still adjacent to the firm's knowledge base and thus more likely to be improved than discontinued quickly.

Because the round glass track luminaires were only mentioned rather than fully presented, they look like a weaker and less validated variant, making withdrawal more likely if early signals have not justified further absorption and development effort.
